name: The Disruption Ends
summary: Along the Horde road, Thork orders a strike to end the Razormane raids. Kreenig Snarlsnout leads the attacks from the northern Barrens, and his death is meant to break the warband's hold on the route between Durotar and the Crossroads.

sections.title: Cutting the Head
sections.body: The road between Durotar and the Crossroads carries provisions and reinforcements through the northern Barrens. Razormane quilboar ambushes threaten that passage. Scout reports name Kreenig Snarlsnout as their leader. His raiding party organizes the attacks, so Thork orders a strike against him to break the warband's unity and secure the road.

sections.title: Breaching the Encampment
sections.body: Kreenig's war party holds craggy hills northeast of the Crossroads. Hardy Razormane Defenders and geomancers who manipulate the arid earth shield his position. Thork orders a breach through their guard and a strike against Kreenig in his redoubt. His tusk will prove the leader's death and warn the plains that the Horde will not accept attacks on its lifelines.

faq.answer: Kreenig Snarlsnout is a Razormane quilboar raid leader northeast of the Crossroads. He organized attacks on Horde caravans on the main road from Durotar, so Thork orders his execution.
Kreenig Snarlsnout is in the quilboar encampments northeast of the Crossroads, against the mountain foothills just south of the main road from Durotar.

faq.q: Why does Thork want Kreenig's tusk?
faq.answer: A tusk carries cultural weight among orcs and quilboar. Kreenig's tusk proves his death and marks his defeat, demoralizing the remaining Razormane fighters.

faq.q: How does killing Kreenig help the Crossroads?
faq.answer: Thork believes quilboar warbands fall into chaos without strong leadership. Kreenig's death disrupts their coordination and curbs caravan ambushes, making the road from Durotar safer for travelers.

faq.q: What role do Razormane Geomancers play in the tribe?
faq.answer: Razormane Geomancers are quilboar spellcasters who commune with earth and stone spirits. They use nature magic to raise jagged thorn barriers and shape the rugged terrain around their bramble encampments to repel invaders.

aliases: what comes before the disruption ends
faq.answer: This assignment follows Disrupt the Attacks, when scouts first identified the Razormane tribe's role in caravan raids along the eastern frontier.

angles.text: The road between Durotar and the Crossroads is vital to Horde expansion in Kalimdor. Keeping it open helps inland outposts survive.
As an orc, you know Thork's approach: break the enemy's resolve by cutting down its chieftain before his warriors.
